newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list tractor maker Uzel.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list tractor maker Uzel.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange said it would list partial shares of leading Turkish tractor producer Uzel Makina Sanayii AS on the national market on Tuesday.
The opening price will be 19,500 lira per 1,000 lira nominal valued share, the Exchange said in a statement.
The company last week floated 345 billion lira or 15 percent of its capital at the same price in a two-day public offer.

Of the total offer, 293.25 billion lira worth shares, or 85 percent of the offer were sold to 64 institutional investors abroad and 31.836 billion lira of shares were sold to 15,601 domestic individual investors, broker Yatirim Finansman said.
It said 15.525 billion lira worth shares were sold to Uzel Makina employees and sales agencies and 4.389 billion lira to 27 domestic institutional investors.
Britain-based European Trust which bought 20.62 billion lira worth of shares in the offer was among the foreign investors.

In a separate statement, Yatirim Finansman said Uzel Makina would offer an optional 51.75 billion lira worth shares to investors abroad within 30 days. The price in the optional offer will also be 19,500 lira per 1,000 lira nominal valued share.
Uzel Makina produces Massey-Ferguson tractors and Perkins engines as well as rims and springs for the automotive industry.
